rci1_using_msad.detail: Single-site in-house cohort recruited at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University; no multi-site aggregation indicated
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "This study adhered to the principles outlined in the Helsinki Declaration and obtained approval from the research ethics committee of the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort is an in-house community sample; no established public datasets reported
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Healthy controls (HCs, n = 104) were enlisted from the community via poster advertisements."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; healthy controls used to train the normative model
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Healthy controls (HCs, n = 104) were enlisted from the community via poster advertisements."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; female_n inferred from total HC N=104 minus reported male_n=51; percentages rounded to one decimal

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age in years; range not reported for HCs
